turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mrs. Iyer from Lucknow?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is she. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Maam, I am Rohan from the Global Logistics clearance cell. We have a heavy parcel for you that has been detained by customs.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Parcel? I am not expecting any package, maybe it is a mistake.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is marked as a high-value gift from overseas, but there is a legal discrepancy with the declarations.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh dear, what kind of discrepancy? Is it something serious?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is a customs violation, and if not cleared in two hours, the police will be notified for an investigation.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Police? Please, I am a law abiding citizen, I do not know anything about this.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not worry, you can settle the penalty of twenty five thousand rupees now to avoid any legal trouble.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Twenty five thousand is a lot of money. Can I come to the office and pay?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No maam, the office is closed for audit. Just send the amount via UPI or buy Google gift cards and send the codes immediately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Gift cards for a government fine? I must ask my son first.
